newsitem.title: JAPAN: Innotech, Credence Systems to set up Japan venture.
newsitem.headline: Innotech, Credence Systems to set up Japan venture.

text.p: Innotech Corp said on Wednesday that it and Credence Systems Corp of the United States will set up a joint venture next March to manufacture and market semiconductor testers in Japan.
The venture, which will be called Innotech Credence Corp, will be capitalised at 100 million yen. It will be equally owned by Innotech and Credence Systems, an Innotech spokesman said.
The new firm will aim for annual sales of 10 billion yen by 2001, the spokesman said.
The testers are used to pick off defective semiconductors from the manufacturing line.
